title: Abyssals v0.90.23 — Arena Boss Rounds
notes: Every fifth Mark arena round is a six-partner boss encounter. Five curated teams rotate through rain, sun, sand, screens and poison, and relay strategies, with legal moves, selected abilities and held-item roles. Boss AI chooses effective attacks, uses setup and support purposefully, switches for matchups or relay boosts with a cooldown, and shares two half-HP Grand Poultices across its entire team. Switching and item use consume the enemy action. Boss wins award 10 times the round number: 50 Marks at round 5, 100 at 10, 150 at 15, and so on. Preview and victory screens show the correct rewards; saved runs, full recovery of survivors between rounds, permanent death, unique encounters and existing training improvements are preserved. GitHub Actions source/browser checks and original-key Android signing; no physical-phone testing.
